title: CT-680 Large Desktop Basic Calculator 12 Digit
body_html: Celect CT-680 is a large 12-digit desktop basic calculator with a big display and large keys for everyday shop, office and school use.

details.description: Celect CT-680 is a large 12-digit desktop basic calculator with a big display and large keys for everyday shop, office and school use.
details.usageInstructions: Press ON/AC to switch on, enter the numbers and operators, then press = for the result. Use the solar panel in good light or replace the battery when the display fades.
details.dangerWarnings: Do not drop, wet or press hard on the keys. Keep away from small children. Replace the battery only with the same type.

title: CT-786 Basic Calculator 12 Digit
body_html: Celect CT-786 is a compact 12-digit basic calculator with dual solar and battery power and a step-replay memory for checking entries.

title: CE-991MS II-D 2nd Edition Scientific Calculator
body_html: Celect CE-991MS II-D (2nd Edition) is a 12-digit two-line scientific calculator with 401 functions, solar power with battery backup and a slide-on cover, for school and college maths and science.
